project_info.theme: Taiwan county and city mayor election voting process
project_info.color_palette: Pale blue-gray, navy, teal, white, muted green, coral-red prohibition icons

main_subject.detail: A Traditional-Chinese voting guide shows four illustrated actions: check in, receive ballot, mark ballot in booth, and cast ballot, with a carry-items panel and rules panel.
main_subject.style: Friendly flat civic illustration, rounded cards, consistent navy outlines, plain-language educational hierarchy

composition_elements.text: 台灣縣市長選舉投票流程圖表; 攜帶物品與注意事項; 1.報到 (Check-in); 2.領票 (Receive Ballot); 3.圈票 (Mark Ballot); 4.投票 (Cast Ballot); 攜帶物品; 身分證; 投票通知單; 印章; 注意事項; 禁止拍照; 手機關機; 保持安靜
items: Top: bold Traditional-Chinese headline and rounded subtitle pill.
Left: four numbered election actions in a zigzag path connected by teal arrows.
Right Top: white rounded carry-items card with ID, voting notice, and seal illustrations.
Right Bottom: white rounded rules card with crossed-out camera, phone, and sound icons.
Background: pale blue-gray field with restrained, official visual tone.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even paper-like color fills, crisp outlines, quiet public-service clarity, no photo lighting

assets.name: Traditional-Chinese election instructions
assets.source: current official Taiwan election authority copy
assets.usage: Use only currently valid official wording, process, and rules; proofread every Chinese character.

assets.name: ID, ballot, seal, camera, phone, and quiet icons
assets.usage: Preserve the simple friendly illustrated style.

assets.name: four-step voting flow
assets.usage: Keep the left-side zigzag sequence and right-side reminder cards.

prompt_instructions: Verify all election guidance against the current official Taiwan election authority before publication.
Do not use image-generation output as final Traditional-Chinese typesetting.
Avoid logos or political endorsements unless formally authorized.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A flowchart of the voting process and important notes for Taiwan county and city mayor elections, in Traditional Chinese, in an illustrated infographic style.
prompt.negative_prompt: incorrect voting instructions, political endorsement, garbled Traditional Chinese, changed step order, cluttered layout, low contrast, watermark, signature
